evals.prompt: 我想从零写一个 LSPosed 模块，hook com.example.target 里 com.example.target.MainActivity 的 getTitleText(String) 方法，把参数和返回值打到 logcat。请给出最小可运行项目需要的文件和代码。
evals.expected_output: A modern libxposed skeleton with java_init.list, module.prop, scope.list, manifest label/description, entry class extending XposedModule, package filtering, classloader use, hook/interceptor code, and build/install/debug notes.
expectations: Chooses modern libxposed API for a new LSPosed module
Filters by target package before installing hooks
Explains build, enable scope, restart, and logcat verification

evals.prompt: 这个老 Xposed 模块只有 MainHook.java，LSPosed 里不显示。它 implements IXposedHookLoadPackage，用 XposedHelpers.findAndHookMethod。帮我指出应该补哪些文件，不要迁移到 modern API。
evals.expected_output: A legacy XposedBridge-focused answer that keeps IXposedHookLoadPackage, adds assets/xposed_init, manifest xposed metadata, compileOnly dependency guidance, and LSPosed activation/scope troubleshooting.
expectations: Keeps the project on legacy XposedBridge because the user requested no migration
Mentions app/src/main/assets/xposed_init with the fully qualified entry class
Mentions compileOnly for the Xposed API dependency

evals.prompt: 我想把一个 legacy XposedBridge 模块迁到 libxposed。现在有 assets/xposed_init、xposedmodule metadata、IXposedHookLoadPackage、XposedHelpers.findAndHookMethod 和一个资源 hook。请给我迁移清单和哪些东西不能直接迁。
evals.expected_output: A migration checklist explaining entry/metadata/scope changes, XposedModule lifecycle mapping, hook API rewrite, dependency separation, and warning that resource hooks are removed in modern API.
expectations: Explains legacy manifest metadata is replaced by label/description and module.prop
Explains IXposedHookLoadPackage maps to modern lifecycle callbacks such as onPackageReady
Warns that legacy resource hooks are not supported by the modern API
Warns not to mix modern libxposed and legacy XposedBridge APIs casually
